input.request: Write to the scolarité office to ask for a certificate of enrolment for my visa appointment on Thursday 3 December.

instructions.body: Write to the scolarité office to ask for a certificate of enrolment for my visa appointment on Thursday 3 December.

items.text: Ask the scolarité office for a certificate of enrolment.
Needed for the visa appointment on Thursday 3 December.

input.brief: Ask for a certificate of enrolment for the visa appointment on Thursday 3 December. No language named: use the language of the request (English). Tone: administration.

draft.subject: Request for a certificate of enrolment
draft.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Je vous prie de bien vouloir me délivrer un certificat de scolarité, nécessaire pour mon rendez-vous de visa du jeudi 3 décembre.

Cordialement,
Tom Okafor
